title: Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee — reproduction package
description: Experiment scripts, raw results (including IBM Quantum job identifiers and the raw counts of hardware rounds 2 and 3), solver modules and LaTeX source for the paper 'Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee: Design and Empirical Lessons from a Vendor-Neutral Hybrid Quantum-Classical Platform'. Version 2.0.0 covers experiments E1 to E25: amplitude estimation against classical Monte Carlo with the Cramer-Rao bound; facility location against an exact MILP referee; Rydberg MIS mappings with a tuned control; sample-based diagonalization (SqDRIFT and SQD) against random strings, an FCI-weight oracle and selected CI; vehicle routing; QAOA evaluated exactly; portfolio selection (QAOA, CVaR-VQE, PCE, BF-DCQO) against the exact optimum and uniform nulls, before and after correction; and three hardware rounds on IBM Heron (ibm_marrakesh). Version 1.0.0 held the results of the earlier version of the paper, including those the paper's audit invalidated; it is kept for the record.
